questions.question: When may you enter a yellow box junction to go straight ahead?
options: Only when your exit road is clear
questions.explanation: You must not enter a box junction unless your exit is clear.

questions.question: When may you wait inside a yellow box junction?
options: Turning right and blocked by oncoming traffic
Going straight in a slow queue
questions.explanation: You may wait inside only when turning right and blocked by oncoming traffic.
